<h1>Geospatial data science for environmental change and decision-making.</h1>
<div class="lead">We study how climate change, migration, urbanization, and environmental change reshape landscapes and communities. Our work combines spatial modeling, GeoAI, remote sensing, participatory GIS, and visualization to understand these processes and support better environmental decisions.</div>

<div class="section-kicker">Research agenda</div>

## Questions that connect our work {.section-title}

<div class="research-lines">
<div class="research-line"><div class="research-index">01</div><h3>Climate adaptation, migration & urban futures</h3><p>How will climate-related migration reshape cities, land use, infrastructure, environmental quality, and inequality?</p></div>
<div class="research-line"><div class="research-index">02</div><h3>Geospatial AI & spatial data science</h3><p>How can AI and large spatial datasets produce meaningful, scalable, and responsible information about environmental and urban conditions?</p></div>
<div class="research-line"><div class="research-index">03</div><h3>Participatory GIS & environmental decision-making</h3><p>How can local knowledge, community priorities, and environmental models be integrated into transparent planning and scenario analysis?</p></div>
<div class="research-line"><div class="research-index">04</div><h3>Landscape perception, conservation & human–environment relationships</h3><p>How do people perceive, value, and interact with landscapes, and how can those relationships inform conservation and planning?</p></div>
</div>

<div class="section-kicker">Selected projects</div>
